editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a guy who hates commitment has to pretend he is actually in love? You get a wild ride with a professional heartbreaker who is tired of his friends giving him a hard time. To shut them up, he brings in his gorgeous cousin from the UK to play the part of his new girlfriend. The vibe is light, silly, and full of the kind of awkward moments that make rom-coms so fun to watch. You will find yourself rooting for them even though the whole setup is a total lie, and the chemistry between the leads keeps things feeling fresh and energetic throughout the film.

The acting is surprisingly punchy, and the comedic timing makes the jokes land just right. While the plot is pretty simple and follows some old tropes, it works because the characters are so likable. If you are looking for a low-stress movie for a date night or a lazy Sunday, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the lie finally falls apart and the friends find out the truth about the relationship. Instead of staying angry, the main character realizes that pretending to be in love actually taught him how to be a better person. He stops being a heartbreaker and finds real love. The movie wraps up with a sweet moment where the fake relationship turns into a real emotional bond, leaving everyone happy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy romantic comedies and fake dating stories.
